lines.trans: Quickly, call an ambulance immediately!
Vitya, tell me, what happened to him?
It seems he was poisoned by Japanese fugu fish.
Where did fugu fish come from in our restaurant?
I do not understand how this happened myself.
Vitya, what have you done again?
Chef, how are you feeling right now?
Wonderful, and how is our Nagiyev over there?
But how did you get poisoned yourself, Chef?
Did you fillet that fugu fish improperly?
I did everything absolutely right.
I just rushed to save you and forgot to change gloves.

examples.text: Ты абсолютно прав.
examples.trans: You are absolutely right.

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Вы что, неправильно разделали эту фугу?
examples.trans: Did you fillet that fugu fish improperly?

examples.text: Да я всё абсолютно правильно сделал.
examples.trans: I did everything absolutely right.

examples.text: Это правильно.
examples.trans: That's right.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'делать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'made', paired with 'делать'.

examples.text: Зачем вы это сделали, Виктор Петрович?
examples.trans: Why did you do that, Viktor Petrovich?

examples.text: Да я всё абсолютно правильно сделал.
examples.trans: I did everything absolutely right.

examples.text: Мы сделали много.
examples.trans: We've done a lot.

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Ничего особенного, она просто засыпает.
examples.trans: Nothing special, she is simply falling asleep.

examples.text: Элеонора уговорила, просто слёзно меня просила.
examples.trans: Eleonora persuaded me, she practically begged me in tears.

examples.text: Просто Элеонора сейчас тяжело болеет.
examples.trans: It is just that Eleonora is seriously ill right now.

meanings.en: to hurry, rush, be in a hurry
meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'пешить'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'hurried', paired with 'поспешить'.

examples.text: Просто спешил спасти тебя и забыл сменить перчатки.
examples.trans: I just rushed to save you and forgot to change gloves.

examples.text: А куда нам с тобой теперь спешить?
examples.trans: And where do you and I have to hurry now?

examples.text: Что случилось? Куда ты спешишь?
examples.trans: What happened? Where are you rushing to?

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'пасти'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to save', paired with 'спасать'.

examples.text: Спасибо, Гуля, мне очень приятно слышать.
examples.trans: Thank you, Gulya, I am very pleased to hear that.

examples.text: Видит бог, я искренне хотел тебя спасти.
examples.trans: God knows, I sincerely wanted to save you.

examples.text: Просто спешил спасти тебя и забыл сменить перчатки.
examples.trans: I just rushed to save you and forgot to change gloves.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian clause-linking conjunction meaning 'and', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Сегодня самый лучший день в моей жизни.
examples.trans: Today is the very best day of my life.

examples.text: Буквально минуту назад она мне улыбалась.
examples.trans: Literally a minute ago she was smiling at me.

examples.text: Ничего особенного, она просто засыпает.
examples.trans: Nothing special, she is simply falling asleep.

meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'быть'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to forget', paired with 'забывать'.

examples.text: Просто спешил спасти тебя и забыл сменить перчатки.
examples.trans: I just rushed to save you and forgot to change gloves.

examples.text: Забыл сменить перчатки.
examples.trans: I forgot to change gloves.

examples.text: Не забудь помыть унитаз.
examples.trans: Don't forget to wash the toilet.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'менить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to change / replace'.

examples.text: Просто спешил спасти тебя и забыл сменить перчатки.
examples.trans: I just rushed to save you and forgot to change gloves.

examples.text: Забыл сменить перчатки.
examples.trans: I forgot to change gloves.

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'gloves' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Немедленно защитные перчатки на руки надень!
examples.trans: Put protective gloves on your hands immediately!

examples.text: Немедленно перчатки надень!
examples.trans: Put on gloves immediately!

examples.text: Просто спешил спасти тебя и забыл сменить перчатки.
examples.trans: I just rushed to save you and forgot to change gloves.
